verdict.rationale: The 01 is explicitly a natural-language voice interface for computers. Users speak to a server that processes the input and executes commands, including running code, browsing the web, managing files and controlling third-party software. It also supports OpenAI's Realtime API voice mode and has mobile, desktop and ESP32 clients. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably in practice (all evidence is first-party).
